notes.title: 👻 MOOORE FIXES
notes.content: [p]Thank you so much for all your feedback over the past days! 💜 With your help we were able to track down many bugs and already implemented some of your wishes. Please keep going with reviews, feedback through the in-game tool, and your streams – it helps us a lot! [b]☕[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]💀 PATCH NOTES 👻[/b][/h2][p][b][i]⭐️ Community Feedback[/i][/b][/p][p][b]🕯️ added[/b][/p][p][b]🔨 fixed[/b][/p][p][b]🎃 changed[/b][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Tutorial[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🕯️[b][i]⭐️[/i][/b] Hint box: Click on dirt → shows effect on Cleanliness & Café Rating[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️[b][i]⭐️[/i][/b] Hint box: Click on customer → explains Customer Interaction & Service[/p][/*][*][p]🔨[i][b]⭐️[/b][/i] Smogh dialogue no longer disappears too quickly[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 “Coins” are now called “Soul Coins”[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Example price range adjusted[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Café[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔨 Time no longer continues after midnight[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Orders after midnight are now delivered correctly[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Ambient rating now updates correctly[/p][/*][*][p]🔨[b][i]⭐️[/i][/b] Customers no longer get stuck after café closing when time stops[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Missing localization key for customers fixed[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Exploit fixed: Sold coffee can no longer be taken back from customers and resold[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Additional lamps added in the starting café[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Some starting objects have been rearranged[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Maximum points for ambient rating halved[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visual[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🕯️ Smogh now appears on a stand if not attached to a lamp[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Different coffee powder colors added for better distinction[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Smogh no longer sinks into surfaces[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Counter bell no longer floats in the air[/p][/*][*][p]🔨[i][b]⭐️[/b][/i] Shipping box no longer glitches through the floor[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🕯️ Discord button added to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Steam button added to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Cleanliness display no longer remains permanently visible[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Budget no longer shows $ after purchases[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Save System[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔨 Day & time now load and display correctly[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Empty coffee bags are now shown as crumpled[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Kettle can be picked up again after being loaded on the stand[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Flavours are now correctly loaded onto the offer board (Mild is no longer added automatically)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔨 Players no longer get stuck on the backyard door[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Grin Doll Easter Egg now only appears in the intended Twitch channel and no longer globally[/p][/*][*][p]🎃[i][b]⭐️[/b][/i] “End of Day” sound effect reworked[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Starting delivery deposit is no longer pickable[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Starting delivery deposit has been repositioned[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]As always, we also fixed many other small bugs and implemented further improvements. Feel free to join our [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord[/url] if you’d like to keep supporting us with feedback![/p]

notes.title: 👻 DAY ONE PATCH
notes.content: [p]A weekend has passed since the demo release and we are incredibly grateful for all the positive feedback. We already have over 200 plays of the demo and also surpassed the 1,000 wishlist milestone! Thank you so much. We’ve read your feedback and implemented the first changes into the game. Enjoy the patch. [b]☕[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]💀 PATCH NOTES 👻[/b][/h2][p][b][i]⭐️ community feedback[/i][/b][/p][p][b]🕯️ added[/b][/p][p][b]🔨 fixed[/b][/p][p][b]🎃 changed[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Tutorial[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]🕯️[i]⭐️[/i] Checklist: making coffee[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️[i]⭐️[/i] Checklist: café preparation[/p][/*][*][p]🔨[i]⭐️[/i] Tutorial softlock after completion[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dialogues[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]🕯️ Option to disable dialog text animations added[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Dialog speed slider inverted (fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]🎃[i]⭐️[/i] When skipping a dialogue, the full text is now shown first; another click moves to the next dialogue[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Café[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]🕯️ Daily revenue and tips are now shown on the day-change screen[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Sound for manual shop closing added[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Sound for automatic shop closing added[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Sound for shop opening added[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Sound for sign/board flip added[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Customer wait-time popup now changes to a house icon after closing[/p][/*][*][p]🕯️ Customers now point out excessively high prices[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 When the café is open, the “Open” sign now faces outward (fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Text input on the specials board was not confirmed after leaving (fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]🔨[i]⭐️[/i] Repeatedly pressing ESC when leaving the specials board shifted the camera[/p][/*][*][p]🎃[i]⭐️[/i] Customer spawn rate reduced[/p][/*][*][p]🎃[i]⭐️[/i] Customer wait time increased[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Customer wait time after closing significantly increased[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Customer wait-time popup is now permanently shown after closing[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Customers now point out slightly overpriced items with 100% probability[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Online Shop[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔨 Deliveries arriving shortly before midnight are now scheduled for the next day instead of being rejected[/p][/*][*][p]🎃[i]⭐️[/i] Item descriptions are now easier to read[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Items[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]🔨 Item count overlapped the dialogue box (fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 The kettle now shows “hot” by default[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Localization of “Trash can is full!” corrected[/p][/*][*][p]🎃[i]⭐️[/i] Colliders for ingredients and smaller objects enlarged for easier selection[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 “Remove” (control icon) renamed to “Take”[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 Item display adjusted[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]🔨[i]⭐️[/i] When interacting with Smogh while running, the character kept running without stopping[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 English typos corrected[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 German typos corrected[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 Twitch name in the options menu Enjoy the first patch and keep brewing delightfully spooky coffee.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to chat with other café owners – [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]come join our Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: 👻 My Little Cafe Nightmare DEMO OUT NOW
notes.content:
[p]The time has come! From today onwards, you can play a demo of My Little Cafe Nightmare.
Check it out, enjoy the spooky cafe, decorate and satisfy your customer with deadly good coffee.
In our demo, you will be able to experience some of the content from our full game. Not all of it, but some of it.[/p][h2]💀 [b]Demo Content[/b] 👻[/h2][list][*][p][b]Unlock[/b] 5 out of 10 levels[/p][/*][*][p]30 out of 60 purchasable [b]items[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Experiment with 5 different [b]flavors[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decorate[/b] and [b]expand[/b] your [b]Café[/b] by up to 4 rooms[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We are also releasing a brand new trailer for the game alongside the demo! Get a better idea of what you can expect to be doing in the demo:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WCoH5R8Xq0s;full"][/previewyoutube]
